tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Lists the cities ShowTime operates in (e.g. Bengaluru, Delhi). Use the returned city_id values as input to list_movies and list_showtimes.

tools.name: list_movies
tools.description: Lists the movies now showing in a city, with each movie's rating, languages and runtime in minutes. city_id comes from list_cities; movie_id values in the result feed list_showtimes.

inputs.name: city_id
inputs.description: City identifier, e.g. "BLR". Comes from list_cities.

tools.name: list_showtimes
tools.description: Lists showtimes with theatre, start time and price in INR for a movie in a city on a given date (today, tomorrow or the day after). movie_id comes from list_movies, city_id from list_cities; show_id values in the result feed get_seatmap.

inputs.name: movie_id
inputs.description: Movie identifier, e.g. "mv_dune3". Comes from list_movies.

inputs.name: city_id
inputs.description: City identifier, e.g. "BLR". Comes from list_cities.

inputs.name: date
inputs.description: Show date in format YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-11-13. Today, tomorrow or the day after.

tools.name: get_seatmap
tools.description: Shows the live seat map for a showtime, with each row's seats and their status (use it to pick free seats). show_id comes from list_showtimes.

inputs.name: show_id
inputs.description: Show identifier, e.g. 66166. Comes from list_showtimes.

tools.name: hold_seats
tools.description: Places a temporary hold (about 10 minutes) on the chosen seats for a showtime. This changes state: confirm the show and seats with the user first. show_id comes from get_seatmap (or list_showtimes); seat_ids must be free seats from get_seatmap. Returns hold_id for checkout_hold.

inputs.name: show_id
inputs.description: Show identifier, e.g. 66166. Comes from get_seatmap.

inputs.name: seat_ids
inputs.description: Seat IDs to hold, e.g. ["A1"]. Choose free seats from get_seatmap.

tools.name: checkout_hold
tools.description: Starts checkout for a held set of seats and returns the secure payment_url and total in INR. This changes state: confirm with the user first. hold_id comes from hold_seats. Does not pay; the user completes payment at the link.

inputs.name: hold_id
inputs.description: Hold identifier, e.g. "hl_1f67509cb8dc". Comes from hold_seats.

tools.name: list_my_bookings
tools.description: Lists the signed-in user's bookings and holds, with show, seats, total in INR, status and time remaining before expiry.
